reason_for_refusal: The report declares a selected RAW-to-FILTERED copy, but the two SHA-256 hashes differ. The canonical filter copies with shutil.copy2, so byte identity is required.
possible_causes: The FILTERED directory was overwritten or assembled by a different run.
The filter report and FILTERED directory come from different executions.
A post-filter transformation changed the selected file without updating provenance.
repair_policy: Do not edit the CSV, replace hashes, remap by rank, or mark G06 eligible. Reconstruct matching runtime evidence first.
